comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers vs clear clutter from a laptop and open its lid safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping, pouring, and bridge clearing vs sequentially relocate fragile/spillable objects and open a stiff hinged lid without moving the base.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% media recovery, washers retained, no spill/damage, screen released vs clutter safely set down, no spill/fall/base movement, lid opened, and objects stable.
comparison.reason: The record tests hazard-aware clutter clearing and hinged opening, not aperture-based separation.
